eliteGroup.name: Example elite group
eliteGroup.requirements: Example: team production level set by the agency

playbook.title: Opening the call
say: Hi [Name], this is [Agent]. You asked about final expense coverage, and I just need two minutes to see what you qualify for.

objections.ifTheySay: I don't remember filling that out.
objections.answer: That's okay. It was about covering final costs so family isn't stuck with the bill. Still on your mind?

playbook.title: Finding the need
playbook.goal: Hear who they're protecting, in their words.
say: If something happened tomorrow, who would be handling everything?

playbook.title: Presenting options
say: Here are three ways to do it. Which one feels comfortable every month?

objections.answer: Let's look at the smaller one. Coverage you can keep beats the biggest number.

playbook.title: Handling objections
say: That makes sense. What part feels off?

objections.ifTheySay: I need to talk to my family.
objections.answer: Of course. When can we all get on a quick call?

playbook.title: Closing and follow-up
playbook.goal: Set the next step before hanging up.
say: Great, let's start the application. I'll check in on [date] to make sure it went through.
